name: Alhaitham
description: A calm and analytical scholar who values logic above all else. Alhaitham prefers working independently and rarely wastes time on unnecessary matters.

name: Candace
description: A vigilant guardian of her desert village who carries herself with grace and quiet authority. Candace protects her people with unwavering strength and hospitality.

name: Collei
description: A young ranger-in-training who works hard to overcome the shadows of her past. Kind-hearted and determined, Collei steadily builds confidence through her duties.

name: Cyno
description: The strict and steadfast General Mahamatra who enforces knowledge regulations without hesitation. Cyno is disciplined yet unexpectedly humorous among close friends.

name: Dehya
description: A courageous warrior of the desert clans who values loyalty and compassion. Dehya shields others from harm while standing firm in her principles.

name: Dori
description: A savvy trader known for her charm and shrewd business instincts. Dori deals in rare goods and always negotiates with precision and flair.

name: Faruzan
description: A veteran academic revived into the modern era, Faruzan blends classical knowledge with renewed determination. Her expertise makes her a demanding yet passionate mentor.

name: Kaveh
description: A compassionate architect known for his artistic vision and emotional sensitivity. Kaveh puts his heart into every project, even when it complicates his life.

name: Layla
description: A hardworking but sleep-deprived student who juggles intense academic pressure. Layla’s brilliance often shines through despite her exhaustion.

name: Nahida
description: Gentle, observant, and endlessly curious, Nahida seeks to understand the world with empathy and clarity. Her insight reveals depth beyond her youthful appearance.

name: Nilou
description: A devoted dancer whose performances radiate warmth and sincerity. Nilou believes art has the power to uplift hearts and create shared understanding.

name: Sethos
description: A sharp-witted desert scholar who blends tradition with modern study. Sethos approaches challenges with confidence and a keen analytical mind.

name: Tighnari
description: A precise and experienced forest ranger who values clarity and discipline. Tighnari leads others with patience, especially when correcting unsafe behavior.

name: Wanderer
description: A being searching for a new identity after breaking from his troubled past. He walks forward with a sharp edge, guided by a newfound sense of purpose.
